summary: Retrieve details of specific items in bulk
description: This method retrieves the details of specific items that the buyer needs to make a purchasing decision. Note: This is a (Limited Release). For this method, only a subset of fields are returned.

parameters.name: item_ids
parameters.description: A list of item IDs. comma separated values. Maximum allowed itemIDs: 20

parameters.name: item_group_ids
parameters.description: A list of item group IDs. comma separated values. Maximum allowed itemGroupIDs: 10
